subject: Post-demo: third-party scope, subprocessor map & security questionnaire kickoff for Acme Health
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acmehealth.com>, Tom Benson <tom.benson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: third-party scope, subprocessor map & security questionnaire kickoff for Acme Health

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks again for your time today. Helpful conversation and good clarity on the main priorities from Acme Health (PHI boundaries, required BAA, and data residency constraints). I wanted to capture immediate next steps and attach the materials we discussed so your security and procurement teams can start their intake.

Attached: redwood-subprocessors-2026-07.csv (current subprocessor list, cloud providers, infra partners), SOC2-summary-2026-07.pdf (scope & controls summary), data_flow-diagram-2026-07.png (high-level data paths).

Quick asks / notes: 
- Can you confirm which environments will receive PHI? (dev/staging/prod) — this affects which subprocessors we call out with PHI access.
- Do you need a completed vendor security questionnaire back within 7 business days or is a two-week window OK? We can start by filling your standard form (please send) and also provide our SOC 2 report under NDA.
- We support a BAA and can provision region-specific endpoints; confirm if data residency must remain in us-east-1 only.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Alicia / security team: share Acme vendor security questionnaire or confirm preferred template.
2) Redwood (Marissa + Vivek): populate the questionnaire, highlight any subprocessor exceptions (we call these out in the attached CSV).
3) Procurement: loop in for BAA / terms — we can prepare a DocuSign-ready BAA and share a draft.

If helpful, we can do a short (30m) follow-up next week with your security owner to walk through the subprocessor list and the data flow diagram. When would work for you?

Thanks — rachel

--
Rachel Kim
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0126
From: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Benson <tom.benson@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com, security@acmehealth.com
Date: Tue, 07 Jul 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: third-party scope, subprocessor map & security questionnaire kickoff for Acme Health

Hi Rachel — really appreciate the recap and the attachments. Quick answers: 
- PHI will be processed in prod only; dev/staging use synthetic or de-identified sets.
- Two-week window for the questionnaire is fine (target by 21 July).
- Data residency: must remain within the United States; preference for us-east or us-west. We won't require a specific AZ, just the region.

I'm attaching Acme's standard vendor security questionnaire (acme-vendor-form-blank.pdf) — it's a straightforward intake. Our security team will also want to see the latest SOC 2 Type II report; can you indicate if the attached SOC2-summary can be shared prior to an NDA, or do you require an NDA first?

Also, Tom (procurement) is copied to confirm required contracting steps (BAA + standard SOW). Will loop procurement on any redlines.

Thanks — Alicia

--
Alicia Torres
Director, Information Security | Acme Health Systems
alicia.torres@acmehealth.com | +1 617-555-8890
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acmehealth.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Jul 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: third-party scope, subprocessor map & security questionnaire kickoff for Acme Health

Hi Alicia — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing the vendor form. A few clarifications from security: 
- SOC 2: we typically provide a SOC 2 Type II summary (controls & coverage) up front. Full SOC 2 reports are shared under an NDA; attached is a 1-page SOC2-summary-2026-07.pdf. If you confirm an NDA, we'll provide the full report through our secure portal.
- PHI handling: Redwood runs PHI workloads only on production clusters that are covered by our HIPAA controls; PHI is encrypted at rest using customer-managed or Redwood-managed KMS (we can indicate the preferred option in the questionnaire).
- Subprocessors: the attached CSV (redwood-subprocessors-2026-07.csv) lists our cloud providers (AWS: managed compute, S3; GCP: optional analytics), telemetry providers, and managed monitoring partners. For PHI paths, the CSV flags which subprocessors touch PHI. Please note: some optional analytics flows use GCP; we can disable those for your account or restrict them to non-PHI data.

Action items we will take now: 
1) Populate Acme's vendor security questionnaire with inline notes on PHI access, encryption, and our SOC2 availability (target: 14 Jul).
2) Prepare a DocuSign-ready BAA draft and share with procurement (Ben will coordinate).
3) If desired, schedule a 30-minute technical walkthrough with our infra team to review the data_flow-diagram and confirm boundaries (Vivek is available next Tue/Thu mornings PST).

Cc'ing Ben to start the contracting thread. Ben — can you draft a BAA + simple SOW and share a DocuSign link by Friday?

Regards,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: Tom Benson <tom.benson@acmehealth.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Alicia Torres <alicia.torres@acmehealth.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: third-party scope, subprocessor map & security questionnaire kickoff for Acme Health

Thanks everyone — this looks good. Procurement confirms: we need a BAA executed before any PHI onboarding. Please route the BAA to procurement@acmehealth.com and include a contact for our legal team. Two asks from our side: 
1) Once Marissa completes the vendor questionnaire, please flag any items that are "exceptions" so procurement can triage quickly.
2) If you can provide a short (15–30m) walkthrough of the data flow diagram with your infra lead, we'd appreciate it. Proposed times: Tue 14 Jul 10:00–10:30am ET or Thu 16 Jul 11:00–11:30am ET.

We'll expect the questionnaire back by 14 Jul if possible so internal review and BAA negotiation can proceed the following week.

Tom

--
Tom Benson
Senior Sourcing Manager | Acme Health Systems
tom.benson@acmehealth.com | +1 212-555-3344
